rows.grounds: compound instrumental singular; internal sandhi not split
optative third plural from root pā

items.question: Which goddesses, pleased by the good-strength ritual, always protect us and are venerable to vīra lords?
items.inference: Proper performance of the good-strength ritual secures protection from the pleased goddesses.
uncertainties: Segmentation of subhabalividhinā into subha, bali, and vidhi is interpretive.
vīrendravandyāḥ may describe the goddesses or the ritual context.
items.plain_english: May the pleased goddesses, always venerable to vīra lords, protect us by the good-strength ritual.
